origin: source_matched_assignment enforces class-by-source counts for A/B and overall source count for C. actual_source_matched also includes unrestricted draws that happen to have matching total source counts.
person_deletion: Remove A/B pair whenever either includes the named worker. Loss of finite-population capacity is reported; resulting different image support means this is descriptive dependence, not a causal worker effect or a new post-deletion full population experiment. No C outcomes borrowed for within support.
role: Post-assessment conditional explanation of previously frozen priority vectors; not a newly validated simple-image rule.
